company_name: China Overseas Grand Oceans Group Limited
model: Developer attributable-profit capitalisation at cost of equity (engine route), growth capital charged on revenue change, blended exit P/E and exit P/B terminal, net debt zero

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (+1.8% 3yr, +5.5% 5yr) diverges far more than 30% from revenue (-13.7% / -3.0%) and EPS (-54.4% / -41.7%). Book has been preserved by retaining the little profit made and by cutting dividends, while earnings collapsed. Equity growth is not a forward growth proxy here; the scenarios are built from contracted sales and margins instead.
historical_growth.notes: Periods FY2022->FY2025 (3yr) and FY2020->FY2025 (5yr). FCF is reported FCF (OCF less PP&E capex); SBC is zero and interest income is not stripped because the company carries net debt. The FCF series swings with land purchases and pre-sale receipts (FY2020 -RMB993m, FY2022 +RMB484m, FY2025 +RMB2,179m), so the 3yr FCF CAGR of +65% is working-capital release in a shrinking business, not growth; the 5yr CAGR is undefined from a negative base.

scenario_narratives.base: Trough in FY2026, flat FY2027, then low-single-digit growth as the H1 2026 contracted-sales recovery (+15.2%) converts. Net margin rebuilds from 0.8% to a 4% mid-cycle (not the 9-12% of FY2018-21) as low-cost 2025-26 land replaces written-down legacy stock. ROE settles at ~4.5-5%, below the 11% cost of equity, so the company is worth well below its RMB9.00/share book.
scenario_narratives.bull: Consolidation favours SOE-backed developers: share gains from failed private peers and cheap land bought at the trough lift revenue 6-8% a year in FY2027-29 and net margin to 6% (ROE ~7%), with exit multiples recovering toward 0.55x book.
scenario_narratives.bear: The national downturn runs another two to three years: revenue falls a further ~25% from FY2025 to FY2028, write-downs on mid-tier-city legacy land keep net margin at 1-2.5%, and the stock stays at distressed multiples (5x earnings, 0.25x book). SOE parentage prevents a default, so the bear case is low returns, not a wipe-out.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A Chinese residential developer is worth what its book earns, not its book. With attributable ROE at ~1% today and ~4.5-5% at a realistic post-boom mid-cycle, below an 11% RMB cost of equity, the company should trade well below its RMB9.00 (HK$10.54) book per share. The valuation capitalises attributable profit, after interest, tax, LAT and NCI, at the cost of equity. It charges equity for the land and work in progress needed to grow, and exits on a blend of P/E and P/B. It deliberately does not use reported FCF or net debt, because both are inventory-cycle noise for a developer.
key_risks_to_valuation: Further inventory write-downs: the cumulative provision is RMB2.88bn against ~RMB32bn of book; a bear path of continuing ~RMB0.5bn/yr charges is in the bear margin, a step-change is not.
Mid-cycle margin: the base 4% net margin rests on ~15-16% gross margins from new land; H1 2026 is 11.8%.

Exit multiple: the terminal holds ~0.4x book against 0.30x today. Exiting at today's 0.30x book (~7.6x FY2035 FCF) would cut the base terminal value by ~15% and the base value by ~6% to ~HK$3.3. The base value is 41% terminal, so the result depends more on the margin path than on the exit multiple.
Related-party allocation inside the COLI/CSCEC group (40% parent) and minority-holder treatment.
RMB/HKD translation: values are RMB converted at 1.1721; refresh_price.py does not update fx_rate.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 1.91-3.35 HKD. FX from Yahoo CNYHKD=X.
data_sources.financials: 0081.HK_Metrics.csv / core_metrics (FY2018-FY2025, H1 2024-H1 2026, RMB millions); kpis table (DeferredRevenue, InterestIncome, CashTaxesPaid, DividendsPaid); FY2025 annual report (write-downs line 4793, provision line 6991, net debt line 8518); H1 2026 interim report (contracted sales, gross margin, land bank, net gearing, dividend FX, lines 180-560 and 1640-1660).

inputs.sbc_source: None: no share option or share award expense in the FY2025 annual report or the H1 2026 interim (grep of both); EquityAwardTaxes 0 FY2018-FY2025. SBC-zero market, so house and street bases coincide and band_position is null.
inputs.fx_note: Flows and statements in RMB (CNY); HKEX quote in HKD. CNY->HKD 1.1721 from Yahoo CNYHKD=X, regularMarketTime 2026-10-10T03:38Z. Cross-check against the filing: the H1 2026 interim dividend of HK$53.391m is stated as about RMB45.770m (interim report note 10), i.e. 1.1665 HKD per RMB at the declaration date, within 0.5% of the live rate, and in the same direction (1 RMB buys more than 1 HKD). There is no dual listing to parity-check against. Per-share values are computed in RMB and multiplied by 1.1721 to give the HKD figures in intrinsic_value / weighted_iv.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-09T08:08:05Z (Yahoo regularMarketTime, Friday regular-session close; HKEX shut over the weekend). 52-week range 1.91-3.35 HKD.
inputs.share_count_basis: 3,559.375m ordinary shares in issue (weighted average 3,559.375m FY2023-FY2025 and H1 2026). There are no options, awards or convertibles, so basic equals fully diluted. No buybacks FY2018-FY2025. Held flat.
inputs.stream_basis: The stream is profit attributable to owners of the Company: after finance costs (interest is ~97% capitalised into properties under development and comes back through cost of sales, so it is inside the margin), after EIT and land appreciation tax, after the non-controlling interests' share and including the share of associate and JV results. The engine fields are used as follows: revenue = consolidated revenue; ebitda_margin_path = attributable net margin; SBC, D&A, capex and cash tax 0 (D&A ~RMB126m and capex ~RMB8m are already inside profit, tax is already deducted); wc_capture_pct charges the equity a developer must retain to grow its land bank and work in progress, on the CHANGE in revenue. Because the stream is post-interest it is capitalised at the cost of equity and net debt is held at zero; deducting net debt afterwards would charge the debt twice.
inputs.fy0_stream_history: Attributable profit RMBm: FY2018 2,043; FY2019 3,330; FY2020 4,375; FY2021 5,051; FY2022 3,150; FY2023 2,302; FY2024 954; FY2025 305 (net margin 0.83%); H1 2025 284; H1 2026 328 (net margin 2.3%). Inventory write-downs charged in profit: FY2024 RMB673m, FY2025 RMB445m (FY2025 AR line 4793); cumulative provision RMB2,880m (line 6991). FY2025 H2 attributable profit was only ~RMB21m after write-downs and LAT settlements.
inputs.balance_sheet_memo: 30 Jun 2026: bank and other borrowings RMB37,978m, cash RMB30,999m, net debt ~RMB6,979m, net gearing 18.5% of total equity RMB37,800m (31.7% at FY2025, net debt RMB12,043m). Equity attributable to owners RMB32,021m = RMB9.00/share = HK$10.54/share; the price is ~0.30x book. NCI RMB5,779m. Lease liabilities ~RMB22m (immaterial; leases left inside profit and outside debt, one treatment). No perpetual securities. Weighted average financing cost 3.3%.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Cost of equity in RMB, because the flows are RMB and the stream is post-interest: China 10y government bond ~1.9% + equity risk premium ~6.5% x beta ~1.3 for a mid-tier-city residential developer = ~10.4%, rounded up to 11% for HK-listing liquidity and the minority position under a 40% SOE parent (related-party allocation risk). The same 11% is used in all three scenarios: sector downturn risk is carried in the scenario flows and weights, not stacked on the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Leases immaterial (RMB22m liabilities); IFRS 16 depreciation and interest stay inside attributable profit and lease liabilities are excluded from debt, which is held at zero in any case.
inputs.nci_treatment: Stream is attributable-only (NCI share of profit already removed), so the RMB5.8bn NCI stock is not deducted again. FY0 stream ties to reported attributable profit RMB305m by construction.
inputs.notes: Model choice: SKILL.md routes an inventory-heavy developer to a blended NTA exit-P/B and earnings exit-P/E model, not an owner-FCF DCF. A developer's reported FCF is dominated by land purchases and pre-sale deposits (FY2019 -RMB9.5bn, FY2023 +RMB9.1bn, H1 2026 +RMB6.0bn) and says nothing about value; net debt is an inventory-funding line, not enterprise leverage. Implemented through the Drivers engine route, as 0012.HK (Henderson Land) was: attributable profit capitalised at the cost of equity, net debt zero, with the terminal cap multiple set to a blend of exit P/E and exit P/B on projected book, and the growth-capital charge on revenue change so that only margin recovery on the existing book is free. Mid-cycle normalisation: margins are NOT normalised to the FY2018-21 boom (9-12% net margin on 23-33% gross margins); the base case mid-cycle is 4.0% attributable net margin (~15-16% gross margin on newly acquired, lower-cost land, ~5.5% selling and admin, LAT/EIT at ~45-55% of pre-tax), giving ~4.5-5% ROE on book. That stays below the 11% cost of equity, so the model values the company below book, as the market does. No prior DCF exists; this is a fresh build. SBC-zero market. Price from Yahoo chart API, regular-session close.

bear.narrative: No national bottom (Fitch: new-home sales value -7-8% in 2026). The H1 2026 rebound fades, the thinning pre-sale book (contract liabilities -28% in FY2025) drags revenue down to ~RMB28bn by FY2028, and mid-tier-city oversupply forces further price cuts on the legacy land bank: write-downs continue at the FY2024-25 pace and net margin stalls at 1-2.5% (ROE ~2%). Dividends stay near the FY2025 HK3.5 cents.
bear.wc_capture_pct_rationale: Lower than the base -35% so that shrinkage releases less cash to equity: in a deeper downturn presale proceeds sit in regulated escrow accounts and management has said it will keep land investment at scale, so a shrinking top line does not hand the full balance-sheet release to shareholders.
bear.terminal_cap_multiple_rationale: Blend of 5x exit P/E and 0.25x exit P/B on ~RMB33bn book, roughly today's distressed-sector multiples; Gordon at 11%/1.5% is 10.7x, so the cap binds.

base.narrative: Revenue troughs in FY2026 at ~RMB33.6bn (-9%): H1 was RMB14.1bn (-2.7%) but contract liabilities at FY2025 were RMB20.1bn (-28%), so H2 recognition is lighter than H2 2025's RMB22.3bn. Contracted sales turned up (+15.2% in H1 2026, attributable +15.5%), so recognised revenue flattens in FY2027 and grows 3-4% as those sales convert, then 2-2.5% nominal. Attributable net margin rebuilds from 0.83% (FY2025, after RMB445m of write-downs) through 1.35% FY2026 (H1 2.3%, H2 typically carries write-downs and LAT true-ups) to a 4.0% mid-cycle by FY2030, as legacy high-cost inventory clears and the 2025-26 land bought at low prices (RMB11.7bn in 2025) delivers ~15-16% gross margins. FY2026 profit ~RMB450m, FY2030 ~RMB1.5bn (RMB0.42/share, ~4.5% ROE).
base.wc_capture_pct_rationale: Growth capital: FY2018-21 attributable equity grew RMB11.7bn while revenue grew RMB32.3bn (0.36 per RMB of revenue); a developer's book is land and WIP. -35% charges that equity on revenue growth. It is symmetric, so the FY2026 decline releases ~RMB1.2bn; that is corroborated (H1 2026 FCF RMB6.0bn, net debt down RMB5.1bn in six months) and is below what the company actually released.
base.terminal_cap_multiple_rationale: Blend of 7x exit P/E (mid-cycle Chinese SOE developer) on FY2035 profit ~RMB1.67bn (= ~8.4x FY2035 FCF of ~RMB1.38bn) and 0.4x exit P/B on ~RMB35bn projected book (= RMB14bn, ~10x FCF), so ~9x. Gordon at 11%/2% is 11.3x, so the cap binds. 0.4x book is above today's 0.30x but below the 0.5-1.0x the sector traded at before 2021.

bull.narrative: The H1 2026 inflection is the bottom. Share gains from exiting private developers continue (14th nationally, #1 in 12 cities), contracted sales grow high-single digits for three years and recognised revenue follows with a one-year lag. Low-cost 2025-26 land and the 'Good Housing' product lift gross margin to ~18-19%, net margin to 6% by FY2030 (~RMB2.6bn profit, ~7% ROE). Funding at 3.3% and SOE backing let the company keep buying land at the bottom of the cycle.
bull.terminal_cap_multiple_rationale: Blend of 8x exit P/E and 0.55x exit P/B on ~RMB40bn book; Gordon at 11%/2.5% is 12.1x, so the cap of 11x binds.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 9x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30% from the 15% house default because the national housing market has no confirmed bottom and FY2026-27 recognised revenue is already set by a pre-sale book that fell 28%. Base held at 50% because the H1 2026 data (contracted sales +15%, gross margin 9.3% -> 11.8%, net gearing 31.7% -> 18.5%) support stabilisation. Bull cut to 20% because it needs both a sector recovery and sustained margin expansion on new land, two things that have not yet happened together.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
